recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is for core. Any future semantic changes to the replaces extension should be made in the FHIR Extension Pack and should preserve the later FHIR-40920 context narrowing unless a new work-group decision supersedes it.
issue_request: FHIR-13818 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested a way for conformance resources to indicate that a new artifact replaces one or more earlier artifacts. The final decision was to create a repeating extension that points backward to the replaced conformance resource with a canonical value.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn 14477. In Git history this corresponds to 47d19ae3e1, whose git-svn-id is build@14477 and which added a replaces row to source/profiles/general-extensions-spreadsheet.xml with %canonicals context expansion, cardinality 0..*, and canonical(Any) value typing.
additional_context: Core fhir.ini still lists MetadataResource, CanonicalResource, and general-extensions, but commit dd468d4f17 removed extension definitions from the R5 core source. Current core only retains the replaces OID, while the authoritative StructureDefinition-replaces.xml lives in the FHIR Extension Pack. Later Published FHIR-40920 intentionally narrowed the replaces contexts where RelatedArtifact already covers the relationship.
reconciliation: No core source was changed. The current Extension Pack definition already provides the repeating canonical replaces extension, so this core reconciliation records that ownership and avoids restoring the obsolete broad core spreadsheet row.

related_jiras.note: Published FHIR-extensions decision removed replaces contexts that overlap with RelatedArtifact on metadata resources, narrowing the original broad conformance-resource context.
Published clarification updated the extension description and confirmed the extension is for canonical resources rather than ordinary clinical or business resources.
